Sandbox_EnshroudedSleep_Enabled_tooltip: Turns Enshrouded Sleep on or off. When some, but not all, living players are asleep, the mod speeds up world/calendar time in proportion to the fraction of players sleeping by reducing MinutesPerDay. It does not globally speed up movement, combat, zombies, vehicle physics, animations, or ordinary timed actions. When everyone living is asleep, Enshrouded Sleep restores the normal day length and lets vanilla Project Zomboid handle full-sleep fast-forward. Turning this off restores the captured native MinutesPerDay baseline.
Sandbox_EnshroudedSleep_PartialSleepSpee: Fine-tunes partial-sleep calendar acceleration; it does NOT replace the normal sleeping-player ratio. Formula: CalendarCompressionFactor = max(1, FastForwardMultiplier × PartialSleepSpeedScale × SleepingPlayers / LivingPlayers). 1.0 uses the normal proportional calculation, 0.5 makes partial-sleep acceleration half as strong, 2.0 makes it twice as strong, and 0.0 disables extra partial-sleep calendar compression. This setting has no effect when everyone is asleep because vanilla full-sleep behavior takes over.
Sandbox_EnshroudedSleep_AwakePlayerProte: Protect awake players during partial sleep (Beta)

Public Beta feature. When enabled, awake living players are normalized toward the survival-needs/metabolism rate expected at the server's native day length while partial sleep compresses world/calendar time. Protected fields are hunger, thirst, fatigue, calories, carbohydrates, proteins, lipids, and weight progression. Sleeping players are never corrected and remain on vanilla sleep physiology. Eating/drinking and tested activity effects are preserved by the directional correction strategy. If a compatibility problem is suspected, turn this option off to return awake survival progression to the older Alpha behavior while leaving proportional partial-sleep calendar compression enabled.
Sandbox_EnshroudedSleep_SleepNotificatio: Server administrator option. When enabled, Enshrouded Sleep posts one short server-chat notification whenever the effective multiplayer sleep state changes. During partial sleep it reports the sleeping/living count, percentage, and settled calendar-time acceleration, for example: [Enshrouded Sleep] 1/2 living players sleeping (50%%). World time is 20x faster. It also reports when all living players are awake or when vanilla full-sleep fast-forward takes over. Disabled by default. This option changes player-facing notifications only; it does not affect sleep policy, time compression, client clock synchronization, or awake-player protection.
Sandbox_EnshroudedSleep_SleepBenefitsEna: Enable Rested / Well Rested sleep benefits

Optional gameplay reward for voluntary sleep. When enabled, qualifying sleep grants one non-stacking Rested or Well Rested benefit based on actual game-world hours slept. Death or disabling this option clears the benefit. Enshrouded Sleep includes its own Rested / Well Rested Moodle display, so no additional UI mod is required. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_EnshroudedSleep_RestedMinimumSle: Minimum game-world hours of continuous in-session sleep needed to earn Rested. Default 6 hours. Sleep below this threshold grants no new benefit and does not cancel an otherwise active benefit.
Sandbox_EnshroudedSleep_RestedDurationHo: How long Rested lasts after waking, measured in game-world hours. Default 12 hours. A later qualifying sleep replaces or refreshes the current benefit rather than stacking with it.
Sandbox_EnshroudedSleep_RestedXPBonusPer: Percentage of additional XP awarded while Rested is active. Default 5%%. The bonus is applied to positive XP gains and added as flat bonus XP so it is not multiplied a second time.
Sandbox_EnshroudedSleep_WellRestedMinimu: Minimum game-world hours of continuous in-session sleep needed to earn Well Rested. Default 9 hours. If configured below the Rested minimum, the runtime safely treats it as equal to the Rested minimum. Sleeping longer than this threshold remains Well Rested; oversleeping does not remove the reward.
Sandbox_EnshroudedSleep_WellRestedDurati: How long Well Rested lasts after waking, measured in game-world hours. Default 24 hours. Benefits do not stack; a later qualifying sleep replaces or refreshes the current tier.
Sandbox_EnshroudedSleep_WellRestedXPBonu: Percentage of additional XP awarded while Well Rested is active. Default 5%%. The bonus is applied to positive XP gains and added as flat bonus XP so it is not multiplied a second time.
Sandbox_EnshroudedSleep_WellRestedEndura: Well Rested: endurance recovery bonus percent

Percentage added to positive Endurance recovery while Well Rested is active. Default 10%%. This does not increase maximum Endurance and does not reduce Endurance expenditure; it only boosts observed positive recovery deltas. Positive Endurance changes from other mods may also be amplified because the correction is directional rather than source-specific.
Sandbox_EnshroudedSleep_DiagnosticsEnabl: Support and development option. When enabled, Enshrouded Sleep records frequent detailed clock, sleep, CharacterStat, Moodle, nutrition, injury, action/activity, awake-protection, and sleep-benefit telemetry on the server and/or clients. This can make log files grow very quickly, especially with multiple players. Leave verbose diagnostics disabled during normal play unless collecting a focused field-test or troubleshooting dataset.
Sandbox_EnshroudedSleep_DiagnosticForced: Forced calendar compression factor (ONE-PLAYER TEST ONLY)

Controlled diagnostic tool; not a gameplay setting. It only operates when verbose diagnostics are enabled, exactly one living player is connected, and that player remains awake. A value above 1 forces MinutesPerDay to the native baseline divided by this factor so time-domain and awake-protection behavior can be tested without another player sleeping. If the player sleeps, another living player connects, or the test conditions stop matching, the override is suspended and native MinutesPerDay is restored. Keep this at 1.0 during normal multiplayer play.
